title.narrative: ''PROFARM: Promoting an integrated farming system around the sunflower, maize and vegetables value chains to stimulate resilient agriculture and nutrition security for smallholder farmers in Rwanda''

description.narrative: The action is designed to be implemented in close collaboration with farmers¿ cooperatives with special attention to women, youth and other vulnerable groups to enhance their sustainability while optimizing their benefits. We will focus on ¿activities enhancing agricultural inputs for local food productivity and availability in Rwanda: crop diversification, irrigation, land husbandry, agro-forestry, mechanization and greenhouses, post-harvest management, food storage, integrated soil fertility management practices, management of pests and diseases¿.
